lead: A `.nvst` case that reads standard error must end in failure, and the runner blames the program rather than the section.
body: `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs` makes any case with an `--EXPECT-ERROR--` section exit non-zero, so a `#[Command]` case that echoes `Core\Command::run()`'s status and returns reports `expected the run to fail, and it succeeded`. End the case with `exit($status as int);`, and prefer `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` with a trailing `%A`.
